jobs.occupation: (Junior) Technical Product Owner (f/m/d) – Virtual Appliance & Container Platform (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Zertificon Solutions – Software Manufacturer since 2004.
We are IT security specialists: our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of the 100 highest-revenue companies in Germany, as well as hundreds of medium-sized enterprises across all industries, already use our Z1 encryption solutions. We have big plans and continue to grow steadily. Nearly 140 employees are already working with us in Neukölln. Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!

Your tasks

We are looking for a Technical Product Owner with a strong technical mindset to drive the evolution of our Z1 Appliance – the virtual foundation for our server-based security products and services. The Z1 Appliance is a core part of our B2B offering: Historically based on Debian Linux, it is now evolving into a modern container-based platform

- As the central interface between development and business teams, you gather requirements from stakeholders and the market and translate them into clear project specifications
- In alignment with our company goals and in close collaboration with the business teams, you develop and own the vision and roadmap for your platform components
- You break down complex feature ideas into epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
- You keep the backlog consistently up to date and well prioritized for your development team
- To ensure strong usability, you create lightweight mockups yourself and coordinate mockups and prototypes for larger features with our UI/UX designers
- You conduct market and competitive analyses to support the platform strategy
- You maintain technology partnerships with virtualization and cloud infrastructure providers and build new collaborations

Your profile

- You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within an agile team
- You bring a strong technical understanding
- Writing epics, user stories, and bug reports comes naturally to you
- You are familiar with Debian Linux as well as modern technologies such as microservices, container technologies (Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructures
- Concepts such as clustering, load balancing, multi-tenancy, storage services, and high availability are not new to you
- Very good English skills (at least C1) enable smooth collaboration in international teams   

Nice to Have:

- Understanding of the design and operation of SaaS infrastructures
- Hands-on experience with UX mockup tools such as Figma or Adobe XD
- German language skills

We offer:

- Flexible hours and home office options
- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking
- Subsidies for meals: (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet
- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness
- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office
- Get-togethers: monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party
- Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals
- Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential
- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture

If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Junior Simulation Software Developer C/C++ (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

The A400M is a versatile European tactical airlifter that bridges the gap between traditional transport aircraft and strategic airlift capabilities. It stands as a symbol of industrial excellence and collaborative defense capability.

Be part of this journey and join our team to shape the future of A400M simulation! We develop advanced simulation software for the A400M programme, ranging from high-fidelity Full Flight Simulators (FFS) for pilot training to advanced test facilities for avionics integration and certification. We support the A400M Military Test and Support Facility (MTSF) by providing simulation models that enable the verification and certification of avionics at software, equipment, and system levels. Our work ensures that aircraft updates are accurately represented in both training and test environments, utilizing a tech stack centered on C/C++.

As a Junior Software Engineer in our MTSF team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of simulation solutions. You will translate high‑level operational and system requirements from a variety of stakeholders into robust simulation models, design and define the necessary simulation interfaces, develop and test complex models, and drive the successful release and deployment of those models. Throughout the process you will guarantee high‑quality delivery and provide support during customer‑acceptance activities.

Your location:

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits:

- Attractive salary including holiday pay, Christmas bonus and profit sharing
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, public transport subsidy, discounts at local businesses
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten nearby

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your responsibilities include:

- Developing simulation models based on avionics software to accurately represent aircraft equipment and systems
- Working closely with customers from aircraft development
- Providing solutions to support testing of real aircraft equipment
- Implementing robust real time software components, primarily using C, and integrating both in-house and third-party modules
- Create requirements, test procedures and supporting documentation and perform formal acceptances
- Designing and defining simulation interfaces in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
- Driving development excellence by creating tools for automation, code generation, and optimized build pipelines
- Supporting the entire deployment cycle, from initial model development to successful integration and customer acceptance
- Working internationally gives you the opportunity to travel occasionally to meet partners on‑site.

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience:

Education:

- We are looking for candidates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline

Professional Experience:

- Relevant experience in the field of software development: - Software design
- Procedural and object orientated programming
- Unit, integration and system testing
- Your proficiency in C/C++ and knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks will be instrumental in this role

Technical Skills:

- Profound knowledge of C/C++
- Knowledge of distributed systems and simulation frameworks
- Scripting languages (e.g. Bash, Python)
- Build Systems (e.g. CMake) and packaging (e.g. conan.io, RPM, DEB)
- Proficiency with Linux and Windows
- Experience with version control systems, office applications, and Atlassian tools (e.g., Confluence, Jira)
- Experience with CI/CD or DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins) and software development (e.g., VS Code)
- Experience with Avionics buses would be a plus
- Experience with real time applications would be a plus

Work Methods and Soft Skills:

- Familiarity and agreement with agile working methods
- Ability to work in large teams and be an excellent team player
- Ability to work independently
- Proactive approach

Language Skills:

- English: Business fluent
- German, Spanish, French or Italian are a plus

jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center is seeking, starting in January 2027, a Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement.

The Single-cell Open Lab (scOpenLab) provides state-of-the-art infrastructure and scientific expertise for single-cell sequencing and spatial omics. Our goal is to enable researchers to perform advanced experiments independently: we advise users on experimental design, provide hands-on training, and support them throughout project optimization, experimental implementation, and library preparation.

Our technology portfolio covers a broad range of single-cell and multi-omic approaches, including single-cell RNA, DNA, and chromatin profiling, as well as spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics. Beyond providing access to established technologies, method development is an important part of our work. We continuously evaluate, adapt, and establish emerging single-cell and spatial technologies and develop customized experimental workflows. Examples include HIPSDR-seq for joint single-cell DNA and RNA profiling and the implementation of new spatial omics approaches. The scOpenLab is also closely involved in MultiSpace, the platform for spatial omics within the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim. Through MultiSpace, we collaborate with other technology platforms and research groups to enable multimodal spatial profiling and the integration of spatial transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular readouts.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a research scientist to cover a period of parental leave and join our interdisciplinary team. The position combines user support and training with hands-on experimental work and technology development, offering the opportunity to work at the forefront of rapidly evolving single-cell and spatial omics technologies with the following tasks:

- Planning and designing spatially resolved transcriptome and proteomics projects with our users
- Training of new users for spatial and single-cell omics assays
- Optimization and integration of new methods in the lab with a focus on multimodal approaches
- Organizing and driving early access programmes
- Scheduling and maintenance of service infrastructure for image-based spatial transcriptomics

Your Profile

jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.

In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.
Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.
In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.

jobs.description:

Our brands BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce and BMW Motorrad have made us one of the world's leading premium manufacturer of cars and motorcycles as well as provider of premium financial and mobility services.

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE CREATE WHEN WE TAKE OUR VISIONS TO THE LIMITS.

PHD AT THE BMW GROUP.

Bridging the gap between your doctoral studies and the kind of career challenge you’re looking for isn’t always easy. That’s why our ProMotion PhD programme gives you the opportunity to apply your passion and scientific expertise to very real challenges that could shape the future of mobility. If selected, you’ll have the chance to really develop your own future career path with us through your practice-related thesis, promote your chosen specialty from within – and position yourself to secure the career you’ve always wanted.

Our New Technologies team explores and evaluates emerging technologies and brings the most promising ones into productive use across the BMW Group. Agentic software engineering is one of these technologies, and as a PhD candidate, you help find ways to systematically measure agentic software development and scale it to real-world use.

What awaits you?

- You design benchmarks that evaluate coding agents on real automotive codebases across the full development lifecycle.
- Within this project, you investigate where agents lose relevant code between exploration and generation - a failure mode that grows with codebase size and remains unmeasured.
- Building on these insights, you explore methods that help agents preserve and use relevant code more effectively.
- In this role, you help develop verification and testing approaches that keep agent-generated code trustworthy without slowing down development.
- Together with the team, you benchmark agent configurations, LLMs, harnesses and scaffolding across heterogeneous stacks such as embedded C/C++, Java, Python and Go.
- Finally, you translate your findings into research and deployment frameworks that can be applied at real-world scale.

What should you bring along?

- Studies in computer science, data science, mathematics or a comparable field.
- Solid knowledge of machine learning, in particular large language models and agentic systems.
- Strong programming skills in Python; experience with C/C++, Java or Go is an advantage.
- Hands-on experience with agent evaluation and benchmarking, for example SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, tau-bench or comparable frameworks.
- Ideally first publications or submissions at relevant scientific venues during your studies.
- Very good English language skills; German is an advantage.

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about shaping the future of biologics development and driving scientific excellence in analytical and microbiological safety strategies? Join Boehringer Ingelheim's CMC Development Biologicals organization and play a key leadership role within the Quality Control team, where you will influence strategic decisions, engage with regulatory authorities and scientific communities, and advance innovative solutions across our development pipeline. Leading a team of highly ambitious experts, you will help strengthen our microbiological and viral safety capabilities while delivering scientific and regulatory excellence for patients worldwide.
Ready to make a meaningful impact and shape the future of biological medicines? We look forward to receiving your application.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
This position has a hybrid setup with a minimum of 3 days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will lead your team by providing clear directions, prioritizing tasks and developing strategies.
- Furthermore, you will contribute to the Quality Control Leadership Team by making continuous improvements, strengthening the team's impact across the development value chain, and leading project-related initiatives.
- You will also Initiate and lead innovation projects by identifying strategic needs in the organization
- In addition, you will develop and maintain solid microbial and virus-safety strategies.
- You will actively contribute and influence the scientific and regulatory community by representing Boehringer Ingelheim at conferences and in industry consortia
- Finally, you will shape the microbiology network within Boehringer Ingelheim and ensure seamless interfaces.

Requirements

- PhD or equivalent advanced degree in Virology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Biology or Biochemistry, or a related quantitative scientific discipline
- Strong scientific expertise in microbiology and virology, with a proven ability to apply knowledge in a research and development environment
- In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices related to microbiology and virology
- Solid knowledge of Novel Biological Entity (NBE) development principles, processes, and associated requirements
- Passion for innovation and emerging technologies, particularly in the detection, characterization, and monitoring of viruses and microorganisms
- Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities
- Demonstrated leadership experience is a plus
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, supported by a strong professional network

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 18, 2026.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid till late October
Step 3: On-site interviews on November 5 & 6, 2026
Please submit your application documents in English or German.

jobs.occupation: Software Architect (d/f/m) (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Software Architect(d/f/m)

You will be joining the Electronic Warfare Ground Support System Software Team.

We develop ground mission systems to support the operation of Defensive Aids Subsystem for our A400M aircraft. Our systems enable mission data elaboration, provide the data interfaces to the onboard systems, and support the evaluation of the mission execution in the context of electronic warfare, defensive aids and sensor fusion.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

As software architect (d/m/w) you will define and develop software solutions:

- You analyze the use cases and needs in close cooperation with the various stakeholders of system engineering team.
- You define and realize the software design and the ability to evaluate different architectural solutions and choose the best solution.
- You are able to understand user workflows and define Software and GUI solutions using specific technologies to support and enhance different steps throughout the mission data production and verification.
- Further- on you will design and implement mission data preparation and verification solutions with the support of state-of-the-art technologies such as Eclipse RCP, OSGI and Java.
- One part of your future tasks will be the preparation and execution of software tests to satisfy the different levels of software verification and validation.
- Finally, you also take care of the integration of activities in the Software Development Lifecycle. You develop according to Software Development Plan and accompanied Standards.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You hold an university degree in computer science or equivalent qualification.
- You consider yourself a Software Architect with: - Object-oriented analysis and design using UML
- Code programming skills in Java, C, Python
- GUI implementation for desktop applications with EMF and SWT
- You have a sound knowledge of development environments (e.g. Eclipse IDE, Git, Maven, SonarQube).
- Special knowledge in data model design and relational database (e.g. Oracle).
- It would be an asset if you have experience in electronic warfare and defensive aids systems
- You are a good communicator with a proactive mindset and the ability to work in a team.
- Agile software development processes and methods are not unfamiliar terms for you.
- You are fluent in English, knowledge in German would be a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!
